sources.title: Godot Demo Projects
sources.description: Official demonstration and template projects for Godot.

rights.notes: Root repository is MIT. Normalize demo-by-demo and retain any third-party notices/assets encountered during ingestion.

sources.title: GDQuest Godot 4 VFX Assets
sources.description: Godot 4 particle, shader and VFX examples with mixed licensing.

rights.notes: Scripts, scenes, shaders and Godot-generated resources are MIT; image textures and 3D models are CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Runtime-safe must exclude the non-commercial subset.

sources.title: Kenney Crosshair Pack
sources.description: A 200-file CC0 asset pack suitable as an initial end-to-end mirrored asset test.

rights.notes: License is explicitly marked on the individual asset page. Do not infer that every file on the broader site is CC0 without checking its page.

sources.title: Project Based Learning
sources.description: Large curated index of project-based programming tutorials.

rights.notes: The index itself is MIT. Linked tutorials are independent upstream works and must be individually verified before mirroring/transcription.

sources.title: Free Programming Books
sources.description: Massive curated index of freely available programming learning resources.

rights.notes: The curated list is CC-BY-4.0; every linked book/course/document keeps independent rights and needs its own evidence before mirroring.

sources.title: NVIDIA Agent Skills
sources.description: Agent Skills designed for coding agents and end-to-end NVIDIA workflows.

rights.notes: Strong reference for AI-native packaging. Ingest skill-by-skill and preserve upstream notices/any file-level license exceptions.

sources.title: Godot Shaders
sources.description: Community-driven Godot shader library and useful discovery source.

rights.notes: No site-wide redistribution license was established from the public landing page. Verify each shader before copying code; otherwise keep link + metadata only.
